note: Small BLM campground in The Gate, a rock notch carved by the Lake Fork of the Gunnison, on the Silver Thread Scenic Byway (SH-149) about 16 miles north of Lake City; short gravel driveway down from the highway. Fishing access on the river. --Claude
summary: BLM page + recreation.gov (10393338, found via search; the stored poi/271729 link is dead) + catalog: confirmed 8 sites, FCFS, $10, vault toilets, hand-pump water. Added max 62 ft (catalog per-site lengths 18-62), 14-night limit, Scan & Pay, fees checked 2026. Note cleaned (field facts and reviewer lengths dropped). Waterfront riverfront -> creekside (the Lake Fork is ~11-15 m wide at the sites).
flags: Phone 970-642-4940 confirmed (BLM Gunnison Field Office: BLM page; recreation.gov facility phone 9706424940).

Website: the stored https://www.recreation.gov/camping/poi/271729 returns Not Found from the API; the campground's current recreation.gov listing is https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/10393338 (Scan & Pay, all FCFS). Replace; keep the BLM page.

Length: BLM gives no figure. recreation.gov's catalog lists per-site Max Vehicle Length 18-62 ft (Driveway Length 18-64), back-in gravel spurs; site 2 is the 62-ft one, 1 and 8 46 ft, 7 38 ft. Recorded 62. Five of eight sites take 23 ft+; sites 3 (18) and 4 (24) are tight.

Access: BLM 'Look for campground entrance sign on the left side of the highway. There is a short gravel driveway down to the campground.' No grade figure, turnaround or RV/trailer wording on the BLM page or recreation.gov. On imagery the driveway leaves SH-149 on the east and runs ~250 m west along the loop to a turnaround around sites 3-5; a second spur reaches 6-8. No closure or alert found on either page.
Season: no operating season stated anywhere (only 'Potable water available seasonally'); season left unset.
Pin 38.24595,-107.26059 (= BLM coordinates) is 50 m from the catalog centroid and 27 m from the nearest site. OK.

Waterfront riverfront -> creekside: on NAIP (0.18 m/px) the Lake Fork of the Gunnison is ~11-15 m of open water at the campground, under the ~30 m riverfront bar, so the size rule makes it creekside. Earned at site 6 (catalog point ~12-15 m from the bank across a grassy bank with a few spruce) and sites 3-5 (~25-35 m across an open grassy flat); sites 1-2 sit ~50 m back under conifers and site 8 ~45 m back. Whether site 7 also qualifies can't be read under the canopy at the east end.
